title: Composition of affine maps of the plane
prompt:
The following 20 transformations of the plane are applied in this order (each to the result of the previous ones):
1. the rotation by 270° counter-clockwise about the origin
2. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x + 2·y, y)
3. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x, y + 2·x)
4. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x + 1·y, y)
5. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x + -1·y, y)
6. the scaling (x, y) ↦ (1/2·x, 1/2·y) about the origin
7. the rotation by 180° counter-clockwise about the origin
8. the rotation by 180° counter-clockwise about the origin
9. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x, y + 2·x)
10. the translation by the vector (-1, 0)
11. the reflection in the line y = −x
12. the scaling (x, y) ↦ (2·x, 2·y) about the origin
13. the scaling (x, y) ↦ (1/2·x, 1/2·y) about the origin
14. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x + -2·y, y)
15. the translation by the vector (-2, 5)
16. the rotation by 270° counter-clockwise about the origin
17. the reflection in the line y = x
18. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x, y + -1·x)
19. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x, y + 2·x)
20. the shear (x, y) ↦ (x + 2·y, y)

Let F be the resulting affine map. Find the images F(A), F(B), F(C) of the points A = (-6, -3), B = (2, -5), C = (-2, 3), and the determinant of the linear part of F. Give 7 exact values — the x and y coordinates of F(A), F(B), F(C), then the determinant — as integers or fractions p/q, separated by commas.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.

title: Leading principal minors of a symmetric matrix
prompt:
For the symmetric 7×7 integer matrix

[  31    7  -10   19   11   -1   -7 ]
[   7   31    7    7    4   20   10 ]
[ -10    7   20   -5   -5    6   10 ]
[  19    7   -5   23    8    2   -5 ]
[  11    4   -5    8   21    8  -12 ]
[  -1   20    6    2    8   25    3 ]
[  -7   10   10   -5  -12    3   19 ]

find all 7 leading principal minors Δ1, …, Δ7 (Δk is the determinant of the upper-left k×k submatrix). Give the 7 exact integers in the order Δ1, …, Δ7, separated by commas.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
